description: This file contains functions for adding command-line flags related to kubeadm options, such as kubeconfig paths, feature gates, control plane arguments, and patches, for the Kubernetes kubeadm CLI.

methods.name: AddKubeConfigFlag
methods.description: Adds the --kubeconfig flag to the provided flagset, setting default path from constants.

methods.name: AddKubeConfigDirFlag
methods.description: Adds the --kubeconfig-dir flag to specify directory for kubeconfig files.

methods.name: AddConfigFlag
methods.description: Adds the --config flag for specifying kubeadm configuration file.

methods.name: AddIgnorePreflightErrorsFlag
methods.description: Adds the --ignore-preflight-errors flag to specify checks to ignore.

methods.name: AddControlPlanExtraArgsFlags
methods.description: Adds extra argument flags for control plane components, with deprecation notices.

methods.name: AddImageMetaFlags
methods.description: Adds --image-repository flag for container registry selection.

methods.name: AddFeatureGatesStringFlag
methods.description: Adds --feature-gates flag with known features list.

methods.name: AddKubeadmOtherFlags
methods.description: Adds flags not bound to configuration files, e.g., --rootfs.

methods.name: AddPatchesFlag
methods.description: Adds --patches flag for specifying patch directory.
